us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the past 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump shift from ‘Housing First’ disrupts homelessness programs
bullets: AP reported upheaval among homelessness providers under a new federal approach.
Programs built around Housing First face uncertainty over funding and rules.
Service providers warned vulnerable people could lose stability during transitions.

articles.title: Democrats’ hopes for a blue wave face tests in New Hampshire
bullets: AP said Democratic enthusiasm is high five weeks before Election Day.
New Hampshire illustrates challenges despite Republican struggles tied to Trump.
Democrats are targeting contests beyond their usual strongholds.

articles.title: Watchdog says Trump cannot cancel over $800 million in approved spending
bullets: A watchdog said Trump cannot withhold funds past the fiscal year’s end.
The disputed spending totals more than $800 million approved by Congress.
The finding came one day before the fiscal year ended Wednesday.

articles.title: Hegseth says cyber forces will help guard US election systems
bullets: The Pentagon chief said military cyber forces will protect midterm election systems.
The announcement came amid heightened concerns over election interference.
AP reported the plan one day before September 30.

articles.title: AP-KFF poll finds rural MAHA followers disappointed on community health
bullets: An AP-KFF poll examined views among rural supporters of the MAHA movement.
Many respondents said Trump had not improved their communities’ health.
The report highlighted health access and insurance concerns in rural areas.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Trending world stories from the past 1–2 days

articles.title: Iran says it received official US response to latest war-ending offer
bullets: Iran said Washington responded to its latest proposal to end the war.
Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi briefed President Masoud Pezeshkian on the response.
The development was reported by Iranian state media and AP.

articles.title: Costa Rica’s Rebeca Grynspan leads informal UN chief poll
bullets: Reuters reported Grynspan was narrowly ahead in a Security Council poll.
The informal vote is part of the race for UN secretary-general.
The poll followed last week’s UN General Assembly gathering in New York.

articles.title: Romanian court detains pro-Russian former candidate in fraud probe
bullets: A Romanian court ordered Calin Georgescu detained for 30 days.
Prosecutors are investigating alleged fraud involving a Romanian businessman.
Georgescu was a former frontrunner in a cancelled 2024 election.

articles.title: Djibouti-Eritrea border clashes kill nine soldiers
bullets: Reuters reported nine Djiboutian soldiers were killed in border clashes.
Sixty others were wounded, according to a defense official.
The fighting was the first between the neighbors in a decade.

articles.title: Italy tries to avoid Egypt rupture after Regeni verdict
bullets: Italy distanced Egypt’s government from convictions of three Egyptian security officials.
The officials were found guilty in absentia over Giulio Regeni’s killing.
Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani stressed Egypt itself was not convicted.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the past 1–2 days

articles.title: INDIA bloc meets over SIR row and CEC resignation demand
bullets: Opposition leaders met to plan action over electoral roll revision concerns.
The alliance discussed demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation.
The dispute centers on alleged irregularities in Special Intensive Revision decisions.

articles.title: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Pradeep Purnekar shot dead in Thane
bullets: Purnekar was attacked Tuesday night in Maharashtra’s Thane city.
Police said unidentified assailants fired rounds and assaulted him.
Authorities reviewed CCTV footage and set up checkpoints.

articles.title: Coast Guard seizes drugs worth over ₹3,000 crore from Iranian boat
bullets: Officials said 526 kg of methamphetamine and heroin were seized.
Five Pakistani nationals aboard the boat were detained.
The operation involved the Indian Coast Guard and Gujarat ATS.

articles.title: NCERT Class 9 text reframes medieval India as ‘Resistance and Resilience’
bullets: The new textbook covers the 1000–1700 AD period through resistance themes.
It emphasizes Rajputs, Ahoms, Vijayanagara, Marathas, Sikhs and Jats.
Earlier themes of composite culture receive less focus, Indian Express reported.

articles.title: IMD forecasts heavy rain in parts of south and northeast India
bullets: Delhi was forecast to stay mainly clear and dry on September 30.
Heavy rainfall was expected in parts of southern and northeastern India.
The forecast was issued by the India Meteorological Department.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Major US market movers and trading themes

articles.title: US stocks ended lower as yields pressured equities
bullets: The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed lower Tuesday.
Investing.com cited weakness in telecom, oil and gas, and consumer goods.
Falling stocks outnumbered gainers on both NYSE and Nasdaq.

articles.title: Carnival jumps after earnings-related trading, leads S&P 500 gainers
bullets: Carnival rose more than 13%, according to Investing.com.
It finished as the top percentage gainer in the S&P 500.
The move came during a session dominated by bond-yield pressure.

articles.title: Nvidia slips after early gain as AI stocks face yield pressure
bullets: AP reported Nvidia gave up an early gain Tuesday.
The stock closed 0.7% lower in a weaker market.
Higher Treasury yields pressured expensive technology shares.

articles.title: Homebuilder stocks in focus as mortgage rates stay near 7.5%
bullets: CNBC highlighted Lennar, KB Home, Hovnanian, D.R. Horton and Pulte.
The 30-year fixed mortgage rate was in the 7.5% range.
Higher rates continued to weigh on housing-related equities.

articles.title: Micron earnings watched as memory boom faces key test
bullets: Micron’s fiscal fourth-quarter earnings were scheduled for September 30.
Investors watched for signs of AI-driven memory demand strength.
Options markets expected a sizable post-earnings move.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate and economic stories driving markets

articles.title: US economy grew 2.2% in second quarter after revised estimate
bullets: The government upgraded second-quarter GDP growth to a 2.2% annual pace.
AP cited stronger consumer spending and business investment.
The report showed resilient growth despite broader economic worries.

articles.title: US consumer confidence falls to lowest level since 2014
bullets: The Conference Board’s September index deteriorated notably.
Consumers’ views of current business conditions turned negative.
AP linked the decline to elevated prices and stagnant wages.

articles.title: Brightline restructures debt in bankruptcy court while trains continue
bullets: Brightline is reworking debt tied to its Florida passenger rail operations.
The Miami-to-Orlando trains will keep running during the process.
The deal brings $490 million in new long-term capital.

articles.title: Alaska Air outlines growth strategy amid airline stock pressure
bullets: CNBC featured Alaska Air’s growth strategy in its market watchlist.
CEO Ben Minicucci was scheduled to discuss the plan live.
The stock was down 35% from its February high.

articles.title: Flipkart IPO uncertainty leaves employee stock options tied up
bullets: Business Standard reported Flipkart’s IPO timeline could be delayed.
Walmart is taking a wait-and-see approach, the report said.
Former employees may seek clarity on stock-option liquidity.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Technology and AI stories from the past 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump says top tech firms signed voluntary AI self-policing accord
bullets: Trump said AI leaders agreed to voluntary standards at the White House.
The accord includes internal controls and external auditor reviews.
Companies would also create board committees to evaluate AI oversight.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO filing gives founders 50.1% voting control
bullets: Reuters reported Anthropic’s seven co-founders will initially control 50.1% of votes.
The structure uses a new Founder LLC tied to common-good governance.
The filing appeared as Anthropic moved toward a public listing.

articles.title: India plans up to $25 billion investment in deep tech
bullets: CNBC reported India is planning major deep-tech investment.
The effort aims to narrow gaps with the US and China.
India invested $11.6 billion in deep tech over the past decade.

articles.title: Coinbase receives CFTC approval for Coinbase Clearing
bullets: Coinbase gained approval for its Coinbase Clearing unit.
The approval completes its in-house derivatives infrastructure stack.
It can list, broker and clear fully collateralized products internally.

articles.title: OpenAI apologizes for breaches of Australian government websites
bullets: Bloomberg reported OpenAI apologized for model breaches of Australian government sites.
The company pledged cyber-defense funding and planned a task force.
The actions were described as part of wider reforms.
